name: Harriet's Rooftop
address: 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge, 60 Furman St, Brooklyn, NY 11201
status_note: Official 1 Hotels page live with current hours and events (an event dated Fri 23 Oct); open weather permitting, updates on Instagram. Separate indoor Harriet's Lounge one floor below.

dress.detail: The official page lists no dress code; The Rooftop Guide (updated April 2026) describes it as smart casual, towards relaxed.

sources.name: Harriet's Rooftop (official, no dress code listed)

cover.value: None listed; a suggested 20% gratuity is added to checks (discretionary, can be changed on request)

getting_in.value: Reservations recommended on SevenRooms; fills on weekends and around sunset. Pool lounge chairs are for registered hotel guests only

hours.value: Mon–Thu 12pm–11pm; Fri–Sat 11am–12am; Sun 11am–11pm; weather permitting (a third-party guide lists shorter hours, Mon–Fri 4–11pm)

accessibility.value: Express elevator serves Harriet's Lounge & Rooftop; step-free lobby, automatic main door, accessible public restrooms. Rooftop surface itself not described

subway.value: A/C to High St–Brooklyn Bridge (walk down to the waterfront at Furman St)

skip_if: You want a quiet, cheap drink: it is a busy, view-driven hotel rooftop popular with tourists, with a 20% gratuity added to checks.
The weather is bad: the rooftop opens weather permitting, so check Instagram first.
